arts.desc: Grabs an adjacent foe: 16 crushing damage, held (stunned) and entangled for a few seconds. Knocks back 1 cell and douses fire.

arts.label: Thorn Volley
arts.desc: Fires a volley of thorn shards at foes up to 9.9 cells away: 11 damage each, 4 shots. May entangle.

arts.label: Sap Mend
arts.desc: Mends the wounds of allies within 5.9 cells (itself included): up to 20 injury healed each.

arts.label: Gale Dive
arts.desc: Dives from the air onto a spot up to 9.9 cells away: 12 damage to everyone within 1.5 cells, allies included, knocked back. Knocks back 2 cells.

arts.label: Moon Howl

arts.label: Moonlit Pounce
